verdict.rationale: Docs claim the same agent can run 'behind a web frontend' or 'as a plain object you call run()', implying you can wrap it in your own API layer, but there is no evidence of a managed runtime/hosting service, one-click deploy, or first-party API-endpoint offering from Pydantic AI itself. Missing for 10: any managed deployment platform, hosting integration, or documented path to expose an agent as a hosted API endpoint without building your own server.
